featured_reviews.name: SaviFun
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Outstanding Institution Shaping Young Minds

St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, stands out as a remarkable institution dedicated to holistic student development. The management's forward-thinking approach is evident in their exceptional infrastructure and innovative curricular and extra-curricular initiatives that cater to children from diverse backgrounds.

The school boasts a team of dedicated, experienced staff who employ creative teaching methods, leveraging TLM and advanced audio-visual techniques, using 4K projectors installed in every classroom and smart TVs for pre-schoolers. This ensures an engaging and enriching learning environment for all students. Principal Madam Mrs. Sunita Fernandes looks after the smooth running of both schools - St. Francis Xavier's High School and Little Rose Nature School.

Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the state-of-the-art SFX Turf and SFX Sports Hall, built to international standards, offering facilities for cricket, football, badminton, and volleyball by Managing Director Mr. Priben Pereira. The school's recent victories in inter-school tournaments further demonstrate its commitment to excellence in sports by guidance of their experienced coaches .

What sets St. Francis Xavier's High School apart is its emphasis on inculcating moral values. Assemblies filled with action songs and words of wisdom, led by the inspiring Manager Sir Mr. Benedict Pereira, nurture students’ minds and align their thoughts with positivity and purpose.

If you're seeking an institution where academic excellence meets character building, St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, is a shining example!

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Chaurasiya
featured_reviews.review_text: We are very happy with this school and the care they provide to our daughter in the nursery class. She has shown a lot of improvement in her learning, communication, and confidence. The teachers are patient, caring, and give individual attention to each child. The school environment is safe, friendly, and encouraging for young kids. We truly appreciate the efforts of the staff and are grateful for the positive foundation they are building for our child.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your experience. Seeing children grow in confidence, communication and social skills is exactly what our preschool curriculum aims to achieve. We’re proud to be part of your child’s development journey.

featured_reviews.review_text: We are very satisfied with Kidzee. The teachers are caring and supportive, and the environment is safe and child-friendly. We have seen positive improvement in our child’s confidence, communication, and learning. Thank you to the entire team for their dedication. 🌸

featured_reviews.name: SHAMIM MERCHANT
featured_reviews.review_text: Kidzee school at Naigaon has a holistic approach towards children and their overall development. The staff is extremely compassionate and gentle. The environment is colourful and totally child friendly. It gives the parents the security that their kid is not only in safe hands, but is also learning while playing. When your baby wants to be more at school than at home, then the school has achieved its objective, I think Naigaon Kidzee has successfully reached that point. Great going!!! Many congratulations and all the best for your future successes😊😊😊😊💐💐💐
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the glowing review! We are committed to helping each child bloom to their fullest potential, and your appreciation means everything to us.
